technical.summary: Bullish structure with Ichimoku cross-up and trend confirmation, but momentum indicators show divergence (RSI not rising, stoch bearish cross, weak volume) suggesting caution on entry timing.

fundamental.summary: NOC shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 65 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional purchases (152+ days old) and absent recent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (373.76) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 65 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Ichimoku tk-cross-up with price above all moving averages and supertrend bullish provides structural confirmation in a fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (373.76), momentum divergence (stoch bearish cross, RSI not rising, weak volume ratio 0.72), zero fundamental conviction, and price below 50/200 EMAs create a high-risk entry despite technical structure.
